cwic_set_start_productivity = {
	cwic_set_target_gdp_1949 = yes
	set_variable = { cwic_start_productivity = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwic_target_gdp_1949 > 0 } }
		gdp_calculation_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { grossdomesticproduct > 0.001 } }
			set_variable = { cwic_start_productivity = cwic_target_gdp_1949 }
			divide_variable = { cwic_start_productivity = grossdomesticproduct }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwic_start_productivity min = 0.001 max = 1000 }
			gdp_calculation_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
